videos.description:
From high above the Pampa de Nazca, the figures pulse awake one by one, each flaring in turn across a plain of ancient straight lines.

A 60-second moment from the finale of "Nazca Plain," a 2-hour ambient space dub visualizer. Binaural movement, deep dub tape delays, no words. Best with headphones.
